parameters.name: check_severity
parameters.description: Checks severity of a patient's symptoms with a deterministic rules engine (no LLM). Returns severity (EMERGENCY/HIGH/MODERATE/LOW), score and reason. Symptoms are snake_case keys like chest_pain.

parameters.name: lookup_condition
parameters.description: Looks up the ICD-style category for a single symptom.

parameters.name: suggest_specialist
parameters.description: Suggests the appropriate medical specialist for a list of symptoms.

parameters.content:
## 6. MCP server
Exposes the deterministic triage as 3 MCP tools (port of mcp_server.py). Use the Production URL of 'Vaidya MCP Server' in any MCP client.
